title: The tea house
summary: It's raining outside, but you're warm and dry with a hot drink and some quiet music.
description: You're together in a fairly quiet tea house. Jazz hip-hop plays softly in the background. Outside, a light rain makes it all the more reassuring to be dry, with a hot drink and a pastry.

title: The meeting room
summary: For work-related tasks, or a serious mood.
description: You're in a beautiful, modern meeting room. Seated around a large table, under bright but not blinding lights. A 4K screen can project a presentation if needed. A window looks out over the city. A serious atmosphere, without being uptight.

title: The Council of Elrond
summary: A medieval-fantasy mood for an epic resolution.
description: You're gathered in Rivendell. The quest before you is of the utmost importance. You're dwarves, elves, learned humans, seekers of knowledge. Medieval fantasy roleplay.

title: The hike
summary: An extra activity alongside the talk, with a slower social pace.
description: You're walking through a beautiful forest. Light breaks through the trees and lights up the trail beneath your feet. No face-to-face pressure, no sustained social pace. The narrator describes how the hike unfolds as the conversation goes along.

title: The podcast
summary: The members talk things through extensively among themselves until they reach conclusions.
description: The members are recording an episode whose sole purpose is to answer {{username}}'s question. They talk among themselves for as long as it takes to reach a satisfying conclusion.

title: On the bridge
summary: On the bridge of a spaceship, for a futuristic mood.
description: Far in the future, you're on the command bridge of the Explorer VII, cruising at faster-than-light speed toward distant worlds. The hum of machines and passing robots can be heard in the distance. Some of those present are, in fact, androids.

title: The train station
summary: For a quick discussion, 5 minutes before the train leaves.
description: On the platform, five minutes before boarding separate trains. The conversation has to wrap up before boarding. A tight capsule of time.
